name: Racing
description: Classic lap racing without weapons. Race progress is everything; frags do not affect the result.
objective: Finish the race in the best time.

name: Racing DM
description: Lap racing with weapons. Every frag takes 500 milliseconds off your recorded finish time.
objective: Win with the best adjusted finish time.

name: Single Player
description: A solo time trial with the lap count set by g_timeTrialLaps. Local play only; unavailable on dedicated servers.

name: Elimination
description: Each lap, the last driver still on that lap is eliminated once everyone else has completed it. Weapons are off unless g_eliminationWeapons is enabled.

name: Sprint
description: A single point-to-point race from start to finish. Requires a sprint map with rally_start and rally_finish.

name: Ghost Race
description: Race against a ghost without AI drivers. Cars do not collide with each other.
objective: Beat the ghost and improve your lap times.

name: Demolition Derby
description: Ram opponents and survive the arena. No weapons: the last car still running wins.
note: Development build: ramming replenishes fuel. Without a hit for 45 seconds your car explodes, with a warning 10 seconds beforehand.

name: Last Car Standing
description: Survival without respawns. The round ends as soon as only one car remains.

name: Deathmatch
description: Free-for-all vehicle combat. Kills score +1 and suicides −1. Play ends at the frag or time limit.

name: Team Deathmatch
description: Deathmatch with team scoring. Each team’s score is the sum of its players’ frags.
objective: Earn the highest team frag score.

name: Team Racing
description: Pure racing with teams ranked by their combined finish times. Frags do not count.
objective: Achieve the best combined team time.

name: Team Racing DM
description: Team racing with weapons. Each frag earns a 500-millisecond time bonus.
objective: Win with the best adjusted team time.

name: Capture the Flag
description: Two teams compete for flags. A capture scores +5, returning a flag +1 and killing the enemy flag carrier +2.
objective: Capture the enemy flag and defend your own.

name: CTF4
description: Four-team Capture the Flag with red, blue, green and yellow teams, coloured HUD messages and team-specific announcer cues.
objective: Outscore three rival teams in flag captures.

name: Domination
description: Capture and hold control points called sigils. Each held point scores at g_dominationScoreInterval, every 10 seconds by default.
objective: Control the map to build your team’s score.

name: King of the Hill
description: Hold the hill uncontested for points. Captures and retaking control award bonuses; players respawn in waves. Tied matches can enter overtime.
objective: Reach the score limit by controlling the hill.

name: Autoball
description: Car football with turbo, high-speed demolitions and golden goal on a tie. Weapons are off by default. Mutators can change ball count, size and gravity.
objective: Drive the ball into the other team’s goal.
